headlines.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Stock May Be Undervalued As Its 96% Run Continues
headlines.summary: Johnson & Johnson has delivered a strong run over the past few years, which naturally raises a question for anyone looking at the stock today. Are investors now paying a price that is fully backed by the cash flows the healthcare group is expected to generate? Over the past 5 years the share price is up 96.4%, which means a lot of future cash generation is already being referenced in the current valuation debate.

headlines.title: Is Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Building a Stronger Post-Stelara Growth Story?
headlines.summary: On September 25, Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) announced top-line findings from its Phase 4 STAR study evaluating Tremfya (guselkumab) in biologic-naïve adults with active psoriatic arthritis (PsA) and axial involvement. Tremfya met primary and secondary endpoints, demonstrating improvements in axial symptoms alongside MRI-confirmed reductions in joint inflammation.

headlines.title: Can J&J’s Latest Trial Win Strengthen its Neuroscience Business?
headlines.summary: Johnson & Johnson’s (NYSE:JNJ) $14.6 billion acquisition of Intra-Cellular Therapies has gained another potential growth avenue after Caplyta met the main goal of a late-stage study in bipolar mania. J&J said Caplyta significantly reduced symptoms of bipolar mania compared with placebo in the Phase 3 trial.

headlines.title: Can J&J’s Partnership Drive More Upside for Nanobiotix?
headlines.summary: Guggenheim has assumed coverage of Nanobiotix S.A. (NASDAQ:NBTX) with a Buy rating and a $64 price target on September 15, putting the company’s Johnson & Johnson-partnered JNJ-1900 at the center of its investment thesis.

headlines.title: Johnson & Johnson’s Next Growth Engine Is Taking Shape
headlines.summary: Johnson & Johnson's oncology and immunology pipeline is firing on multiple cylinders, but a collapsing blockbuster drug and mounting litigation costs threaten to cancel out every gain. Here is whether the bull case or the headwinds win.

description: Johnson & Johnson, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of a range of products in the healthcare field worldwide. It operates in two segments, Innovative Medicine and MedTech. The Innovative Medicine segment offers products for various therapeutic areas, such as oncology, immunology, neuroscience, pulmonary hypertension, infectious diseases, and cardiovascular and metabolism distributed through retailers, wholesalers, distributors, hospitals, and healthcare professionals for prescription use. The MedTech segment provides a portfolio of products used in the surgery, orthopedic, cardiovascular, and vision fields distributed through wholesalers, hospitals and retailers, and used in the professional fields by physicians, nurses, hospitals, eye care professionals and clinics. This segment also offers products and enabling technologies that support joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, sports related injuries, and others, as well as open, laparoscopic, and robotic surgical procedures; instrumentation, energy devices, stapling systems, wound closure, biosurgery products, and digital and robotic technologies; breast aesthetics and reconstruction; contact lenses under the ACUVUE brand; intraocular lenses for cataract surgery, and other products used in cataract and refractive procedures under the TECNIS brand. The company was founded in 1886 and is based in New Brunswick, New Jersey.
